intro: For someone starting out as a Christian, a few questions come first: what the good news is, what has changed, and where to begin reading. These passages are common starting points. Reading them with other people helps.

passages.reason: The best-known summary of the good news, with the verse that follows it: God sent his Son not to judge the world, “but that the world should be saved through him”.
Paul on how a person is saved: “by grace you have been saved through faith”, as a gift and not as something earned.
A short statement of Christian faith: confessing “that Jesus is Lord” and believing that God raised him from the dead.
What Paul says has changed: “if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation”.
What the first believers kept doing together: the apostles’ teaching, fellowship, “the breaking of bread, and prayer”.
A reason for patience with slow growth: “he who began a good work in you will complete it”.
